ambiguousLeads.reason: Two official historical Nesa contracts/Alpha IDs; migration relation unverified; do not pick by ticker.

sources.author: ZachXBT
sources.body: Original investigation URL linked by The Block on 2026-05-14. Direct X retrieval returned 403. Claims of >95% supply control, 226M deposits and 100M withdrawals are unverified allegations; no independently verified beneficial ownership or full transaction reconciliation.

sources.author: Odaily syndicated by Bitget News
sources.body: Secondary report repeats 226M LAB deposits during March–April and 100M withdrawals. Source publication timezone not independently verified; timestamp remains claimed. No transaction hashes/full addresses supplied in this article; exchange custody/operational routing alternatives remain. Verified_source means the publication was read, not that allegations were proven. Correction: the displayed 2026-05-14 12:21 has an unverified timezone; no UTC publication timestamp is asserted.

sources.author: Binance
sources.body: Official announcement schedules Alpha 2025-09-23 09:00 UTC and Futures BLESSUSDT 09:30. Project-level chronology; native Solana versus current BSC representation timing remains unresolved. Do not backdate BSC membership or instrument association from this notice alone.

sources.author: The Block
sources.body: Secondary reporting links the original ZachXBT thread. Publication displays May 14, 2026 10:34 EDT. Reports allegations, not a verified beneficial-owner census. Original thread retrieval is blocked; no reconciled transaction-hash ledger was obtained. Claims cannot become historical ownership labels.

sources.author: Binance
sources.body: Official LAB Alpha buying competition scheduled Nov 28 through Dec 12, 2025. Buys count, sells do not. Project-level earlier Alpha activity conflicts with current registry listingTime in March 2026; representation/metadata chronology remains unresolved. Incentivized gross buying is not proof of retained accumulation.

sources.author: Bless Network
sources.body: Project whitepaper describes native Solana SPL issuance. The current official Alpha registry includes a BSC representation. Bridging, historical representation admission and supply accounting must be verified before treating them as independently issued supply.
